in_sanskrit.name: Bike
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है A motor vehicle with two wheels and a saddle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bike एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A motor vehicle with two wheels and a saddle, often used for transportation and recreation. The name 'Bike' is derived from the word 'bicycle', which was first invented in the late 1800s.
